message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a function that can pull the latest “most assists” data from the Premier League. Based on the records available up to my last update (June 2024), the all‑time leader for assists in the Premier League is **Kevin De Bruyne** (with 140 assists as of the end of the 2022/23 season). If you’re looking for the current season’s assist leader, you’ll need to check the latest stats from the Premier League website or a reputable sports statistics source.

If they want current season, we could say it's currently (2025/26) maybe someone else. But we don't have data. We can respond with best known answer.
